recentItems.description: This was a project for BCU. A section of Wall-E had to be completely stripped of all sound and then rebuilt using all original and new sound FX, music and voices. Pablo voices John, Otto and the Captain.

recentItems.title: Rik Mayall on The Cannon & Ball Show. More Rare Stuff!
recentItems.description: Another rare clip of Rik Mayall from the early 80's. This was his appearence on The Cannon & Ball Show. See my other listings for more rare Rik. Also check out www.2at.tv for comedy sketches.

recentItems.title: Rik Mayall in Nether Wallop with the Jools Holland Big Band.
recentItems.description: This is another rare piece of footage. This is a Rik singing 'Evil' in the big top in Nether Wallop at a big charity gig. It is with Jools Holland's Big Band featuring Bill Wyman, Jools on piano and a bizarre appearence from John Otway on guitar. See my other listings for more rare Rik.

recentItems.title: Rik Mayall. Kevin Turvey in Nether Wallop.More Rare Footage.
recentItems.description: This is another rare piece of footage. This is a big charity gig in a marquee in Nether Wallop. It featured Billy Connelly, Rik, Jools Holland, Smith & Jones and Rowan Atkinson. Here Rik is Kevin Turvey in the early 80's. See my other listings for more rare Rik.
